{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "$id": "brain/graph.schema.md",
  "title": "SYNASE AI project knowledge graph",
  "description": "Shape of brain/graph.json. The file is generated by scripts/brain.mjs from scripts/brain-data.mjs plus measurements taken out of the real source tree by scripts/brain-extract.mjs. Edit the generators, never this file or the JSON it produces.",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["$schema", "generator", "regeneratedBy", "facts", "nodes", "edges"],
  "properties": {
    "$schema": { "const": "brain/graph.schema.md" },
    "generator": { "const": "scripts/brain.mjs" },
    "regeneratedBy": { "const": "npm run brain" },
    "facts": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Measured, not asserted. Every value is counted out of the source tree at generation time.",
      "required": ["generatedAt", "version", "sourceLines", "testLines", "contractTests", "typeExports", "dbCollections", "routes", "serviceMethods", "invariants", "gaps", "risks"],
      "properties": {
        "generatedAt": { "type": "string", "format": "date-time" },
        "version": { "type": "string" },
        "sourceLines": { "type": "integer" },
        "testLines": { "type": "integer" },
        "contractTests": { "type": "integer" },
        "typeExports": { "type": "integer" },
        "dbCollections": { "type": "integer" },
        "routes": { "type": "integer" },
        "serviceMethods": { "type": "integer" },
        "invariants": { "type": "integer" },
        "gaps": { "type": "integer" },
        "risks": { "type": "integer" }
      }
    },
    "nodes": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": ["id", "kind", "label"],
        "properties": {
          "id": { "type": "string", "description": "Stable unique key. Also the id used by edges and by brain-query trace." },
          "kind": {
            "enum": ["product", "layer", "source-file", "type-module", "test-file", "service", "service-method", "entity", "entity-untyped", "route", "nav-section", "in-page-tab", "invariant", "gap", "risk", "decision", "phase", "phase-planned", "script"]
          },
          "label": { "type": "string" }
        },
        "allOf": [
          {
            "if": { "properties": { "kind": { "const": "route" } } },
            "then": { "required": ["path", "match", "view", "module", "phase", "navSection", "status", "backendSupported"] }
          },
          {
            "if": { "properties": { "kind": { "const": "invariant" } } },
            "then": { "required": ["statement", "enforcedBy", "layer"] }
          },
          {
            "if": { "properties": { "kind": { "const": "gap" } } },
            "then": { "required": ["detail", "blocks"] }
          },
          {
            "if": { "properties": { "kind": { "const": "risk" } } },
            "then": { "required": ["severity", "detail", "where"] }
          },
          {
            "if": { "properties": { "kind": { "const": "entity-untyped" } } },
            "then": { "required": ["fixture", "gap"] }
          },
          {
            "if": { "properties": { "kind": { "const": "service-method" } } },
            "then": { "required": ["service", "mutation", "requiresIdempotencyKey"] }
          },
          {
            "if": { "properties": { "kind": { "const": "phase-planned" } } },
            "then": { "required": ["rationale", "deliverables", "resolves"] }
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "edges": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Directed. Every edge endpoints must exist in nodes; the generator enforces this.",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": ["from", "to", "rel"],
        "properties": {
          "from": { "type": "string" },
          "to": { "type": "string" },
          "rel": {
            "enum": ["has-layer", "implemented-by", "calls-into", "exports", "exposes", "exposes-method", "read-via", "declares", "declares-for", "routes-to", "reads-from", "renders-nav", "links-to", "declares-tab", "contains-tab", "governs", "guarantees", "has-gap", "blocks", "has-risk", "observed-on", "decided", "delivered-phase", "surfaced-route", "unblocks", "resolves", "precedes", "bundles", "built-by", "covers", "runs", "blocked-by"]
          },
          "note": { "type": "string" }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
